title: Reject a quantity above the maximum
objective: Confirm that a quantity immediately above the permitted range is rejected without changing the existing quantity.
preconditions: A synthetic DRAFT order line has an existing quantity of 5.

steps.action: Set the order-line quantity to 11 and submit the change.
steps.expected_result: The value is rejected and the existing quantity remains 5.

notes: No rejection message is asserted because ORD-002 does not specify one.
